main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads N weighted points, precomputes per-subset horizontal/vertical nearest distances, then enumerates all ternary axis assignments to output, for each count of assigned axes, the minimum weighted distance." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare variables: int N, X[20], Y[20], P[20], a[20]; long Z[1<<16][16][2]; long ans[20] initialized as {1l<<60}, so ans[0] is the sentinel 1l<<60 and remaining elements default to 0. The ternary-counter logic relies on a[0..N] being zero-initialized; the fixed Z dimensions imply a supported N up to 16 and the code does not validate N. RESULT vars]
            [COMMAND Read integer N from stdin using scanf("%d", &N); ignore the scanf return value. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 to N-1, read X[i], Y[i], and P[i] using scanf("%d%d%d", X+i, Y+i, P+i), and set ans[i+1] to 1l<<60 as the sentinel. RESULT input_arrays]
            [COMMAND For each subset mask i from 0 to (1<<N)-1, for each point index j from 0 to N-1, initialize Z[i][j][0] to abs(X[j]) and Z[i][j][1] to abs(Y[j]); then for each k from 0 to N-1, if bit k of i is set, update Z[i][j][0] to min(Z[i][j][0], (long)abs(X[j]-X[k])) and Z[i][j][1] to min(Z[i][j][1], (long)abs(Y[j]-Y[k])). RESULT Z]
            [COMMAND While a[N] is zero, build bitmasks h and v from the current ternary digits a[0..N-1]: set bit i of h when a[i]==1, and set bit i of v when a[i]==2. RESULT h_v_masks]
            [COMMAND In the same while-loop iteration, compute t = popcount(h|v), initialize sum to 0, then for each i from 0 to N-1 add (long)P[i] * min(Z[h][i][0], Z[v][i][1]) to sum; afterward update ans[t] to min(ans[t], sum). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND In the same while-loop iteration, increment the ternary counter a: start i at 0; while a[i]==2 set a[i]=0 and increment i; then increment a[i]. If all original N digits were 2, this increments the sentinel a[N], terminating the while loop. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND After the ternary enumeration, for each i from 0 through N inclusive, print ans[i] as a long integer with printf("%ld\n", ans[i]). RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main. RESULT exit_code]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
